**Orbweaver 1.0.9 brings remote sessions closer to home: start a chat on another paired desktop, open file links from any machine, and browse a desk's folders from your phone.**

## What's new

- **Start a session on another desktop.** **New Chat** can now start a session on any paired desktop over the peer link, not just this one. (CB-357)
- **Open file links in chat.** Clicking a file link in a chat opens it. If the session runs on another machine, Orbweaver fetches the file from there first. (CB-363)
- **Folder picker for a paired phone.** The phone can browse the folders this desk shares and choose one to work in. (CB-339)
- **Compact rows for teammate messages and compactions.** Teammate and peer messages, and "Conversation compacted" markers, now show as one-line rows you can expand, so they no longer take over the chat. (CB-330, CB-356)
- **Agents submenu in the tray.** The tray menu lists sessions under an **Agents (N)** submenu instead of one long list. (CB-355)
- **Usage merged across PCs.** Usage for the same account now merges across your machines, and the phone shows it in the same style as the desktop. (CB-340)

## What's fixed

- **The live-view banner and composer say where a message will go**, update when the far session becomes reachable or unreachable, and read "can't message" once it's clear there is no live view. (CB-372, CB-379, CB-380)
- **Text you type while a message is sending is kept.** Before, the composer could clear it when the send finished. (CB-376)
- **Cloud panels load their history from the newest messages first**, and a hidden panel catches up on what it missed when you show it. (CB-285)
- **An AskUserQuestion form shown beside a mod pane is read correctly**, and a mod's tool calls no longer change the session's status. (CB-353)
- **A new chat panel stays hidden until it is laid out at its final size**, so it no longer opens at the wrong size and then jumps. (CB-286)
- **File transfers between peers no longer stall** behind a slot that was released too late. (CB-384)
- **If the hook installer times out**, Orbweaver keeps everything it printed before the timeout, so the failure can be diagnosed. (CB-293, CB-370, CB-377)

## Upgrading

- Install 1.0.9 from the update notice, or by hand as usual.
- **macOS:** if your other machines, OpenClaw or the phone relay stop connecting after the upgrade, re-grant Local Network in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
